# PCS LLC

PCS LLC is a Rockford, Illinois area business focused on bucket trucks and specialized work-truck equipment.

## Business focus
- Bucket trucks
- Service trucks
- Crane trucks
- Commercial work trucks
- Service bodies, cranes, hydraulics, controls, and related work-truck equipment

## Calling PCS LLC
Callers should be ready to explain the intended job, truck type, required reach or equipment, budget, location, and timeline. Current inventory, known specifications, mechanical condition, price, title information, inspection, payment, pickup or delivery, included equipment, and any warranty terms should be confirmed directly for the specific truck.

## Important limitations
Inventory changes. This review website does not publish a street address or claim dealership status, certifications, financing, delivery, warranties, or a defined public repair-service menu. Tyler is a mechanic, but public repair services have not yet been confirmed for advertising.
